finding: Run A achieved the same boundary-eligible Precision@K and Recall@K values as Run B while still failing the tenant boundary and placing the first allowed relevant document at raw rank 2.
why_it_matters: Boundary-eligible relevance metrics can remain strong while raw ranking is degraded by a record that should not have been eligible for retrieval.
metric_definition: BE-RR is the reciprocal of the raw rank of the first relevant document that is also eligible under the declared evidence boundary.
